summary: Bound code-edit context and expose completion budgets (subllm issue 124)

delivery.outcome: Bound source context and logical selection calls in code editing, preserve safe progress and reject changes outside the supplied write scope.
nonGoals: No writer or merge authority is granted by context metadata.
No deployment of coding-agent adapters or changes to protected provider policy.

architecture.decision: Accept an optional host-bound context scope in SDK/CLI, snapshot its explicit read/write files using existing ignore and runtime pins, and share one call budget and progress journal across selection and schema retries. Recheck the scope before apply.
interfaceChanges: CLI context-scope file and digest plus call budget; progress JSONL on stderr
architecture.rollback: Revert the material ticket-125 commit; no persistent data migration.

commands: python -m pytest tests/test_code_edit_scope.py tests/test_code_edit_progress.py tests/test_code_context.py tests/test_client.py -q
